text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right! Today's leg presses are
FINISHED!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Man, getting my workout game on just
makes me
wanna work out even more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket catches me off guard
with the
sudden question, and I scramble
for an answer.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's what I'm saying! Working out after
getting
tired is a different kind of fun!
choice_data_list: I get it! I want to go all out, too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Okay! More leg presses it is! Here comes
another
ten sets! The limit doesn't exist
for meee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She begins training furiously again, a
radiant
smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket's determination and
stamina sure
are something.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, a drink! Can I really have this?
Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But why are you giving this to me?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're totally right! All right, I'm
gonna get
my rest game on too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket leaves without taking the
drink. It
seems like she's going to rest as
hard as she
trained. Being able to switch
from work to play is
an essential skill
too.
